cites.quote: select the Last visit column header, then the options are the same as before this change

findings.suggested_fix: Click the Last visit header and assert that the row names and the fetch call count or URL are unchanged.
findings.text: S-3 AC4 asks that selecting the Last visit header leaves the row order unchanged. The test only checks that the header has no button, link or aria-sort. It never clicks the header or compares the row order.

cites.quote: Given a patient with a recorded blood group, allergies, chronic conditions, current medications and notes

findings.suggested_fix: Give the REQ-13 patient a blood group, chronic conditions and medications, and assert that none of those values appear in the list JSON.
findings.text: S-5 AC1 lists blood group, chronic conditions and current medications, but the REQ-13 fixture records only allergies and notes. The regex therefore cannot catch leaks of the other fields.

cites.quote: and their names start with the REQ id (C3)
HMS-4 REQ-2, REQ-3, REQ-4: is the start of the Completed appointment

findings.suggested_fix: Reword the summary to say the names start with 'HMS-4 REQ-n', or rename the tests to match the convention.
findings.text: The artifact says the test names start with the REQ id (C3), but they start with 'HMS-4 ' and then the REQ id.

cites.quote: REQ-1, REQ-6, REQ-8: web tests on the header, the shared format

findings.suggested_fix: Cite C2 (web test layer), or drop the C6 cite from that Known line.

findings.suggested_fix: Remove it, or replace it with an exact expected string such as '10 Mar 2026, 01:00'.
findings.text: The REQ-5/REQ-6 same-format test keeps a weak assertion: any string that contains '10' passes.

rubric_items.reason: Tests cover the repo join, the API field, paging, search, order and the web column (01:00, 23:45, invalid-zone fallback). Untested: S-1 AC5 (no highlight), S-3 AC4 (clicking the header) and S-4 AC2.

Most assertions check observable results: exact ISO starts, row ids per page, Set size 21, exact date/time strings. The REQ-6 test still has a weak toMatch(/10/), and the REQ-13 regex checks only the fixture's allergy and note.

Covered: the error path (invalid status gives 400 with a field error), null/no-visit rows, Cancelled/No-show/Scheduled exclusion, the time-zone boundary and the invalid-zone fallback. Missing: the header-click edge and a highlight check.
Vitest+Supertest with pg harness skipIf and fixed clock for API; Vitest+jsdom+Testing Library for web; files in the existing test locations. Only a small naming deviation.
No counts or coverage are claimed. The artifact defers them to the verifier, and checks.json shows test passing and coverage skipped (exit 78).
